title: Rosa’s Thai
summary: The complete fit-out for Rosa’s Thai, transforming the space into a functional and visually appealing restaurant. The project included custom joinery, tailored interiors, lighting, and strategic layout planning, ensuring operational efficiency while maintaining a welcoming and vibrant atmosphere. Every detail was carefully executed to bring the brand’s vision to life.

approval.note: Client confirmed MENAARC holds the rights to present this project. Source archive: righteousgrp.com.
